similar_in_english: Wear one's heart on one's sleeve
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সঙ্গে কথা বললে মন খোলা হয়ে যায়।
সে খোলা মনে সব বলে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: Talking to him makes my heart open up.

note: The idiom often implies 'মন খোলা' in usage, referring to emotional openness.
